requirement.evidence: The City is also reminding all property owners, landlords, and responsible agents that residential properties offered for rent must be registered annually with the Rent Leveling and Stabilization Office by June 30. The majority of Hoboken rental properties, including many condominium units, are covered under rent control regulations.
requirement.note: Registration by June 30 and coverage of most rentals/condos are supported. Denial of increase for missing proof of rent is supported, and failure to register may forfeit eligibility for increases. But the claim that a tenant can check registration status and appeal through that office is only loosely supported (the webinar mentions records and appeals processes); no explicit tenant right to check status or appeal denial is stated.
